chars.Y: YASSINE: a young Moroccan man (24) wearing a bright red football jersey with thin white vertical stripes (no logo), black tracksuit trousers, white sneakers.
chars.H: HAMZA: his friend, a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, blue jeans and a black cap.
chars.M: MAMA: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a lilac djellaba and a white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a crowded popular Moroccan cafe in Errachidia at night, a football match on a big TV on the wall. YASSINE sits at a small table clutching a paper betting slip with both hands, sweating, eyes huge with panic, staring at the TV. HAMZA next to him grabs his shoulder and stares at him in shock. Mint tea glasses on the table.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close view of YASSINE at the cafe table, holding a thick bundle of Moroccan banknotes in one hand and a paper betting slip in the other, nervous sweat drops, worried face, TV glow behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, a Moroccan bedroom at night lit by a small lamp: YASSINE secretly takes shiny gold bracelets and a gold necklace out of an open wooden jewellery box on a dresser, looking guiltily over his shoulder, while MAMA sleeps peacefully in the bed in the background under a colourful blanket.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the cafe, YASSINE and HAMZA lean forward toward the TV showing a football player running toward the goal, YASSINE on the edge of his chair with clenched fists, hopeful, HAMZA open-mouthed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the cafe, HAMZA leans back relaxed and smiling, giving YASSINE a thumbs up; YASSINE smiles nervously, holding the betting slip close to his chest, the TV match continuing behind them.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE sits in the cafe daydreaming with a big happy grin, eyes half closed; floating dreamy cloud images around his head of a new shiny scooter, new sneakers and a stack of money (no text).

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the cafe, YASSINE bites his nails in anxiety, sweat pouring, staring at the TV where the goalkeeper catches the ball; HAMZA beside him holds his head with both hands.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE imagines running away: he walks alone with a small backpack across the orange sand dunes of the Moroccan desert near Merzouga under a hot sun, looking back worried.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the cafe, YASSINE holds his smartphone which is ringing and vibrating, the screen showing only a photo of MAMA's face; he stares at it terrified, thumb hovering over the power button, HAMZA watching him worried.
